question: Where does search (not compile) time go for simple and complex expressions, and which changes have the largest general effect?
candidate_source_state: Throwaway prototypes (P1 start-byte filter, P2 failed-run skip, P3 reverse run from required literal) applied to the baseline; toggled per regex at compile time through TMP_NO_BCMAP / TMP_NO_RUNSKIP / TMP_NO_REVRUN. Not intended for merge; see prototype_diff.

environment.host: shared cloud VM, 4 vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, Linux 6.18 x86_64
environment.noise_note: Wall-clock timings on this VM vary by up to about 25% between runs (bimodal); only effects far outside that band are claimed. Instruction counts (callgrind) are used where small differences matter.
tools: in-process VM attempt and dispatch counters (throwaway)

method: Compile once, then time best-of-N complete passes over each corpus (N>=3, >=400 ms budget per case and configuration); three interleaved rounds per configuration. Ferroni via ferroni::api (find_iter/is_match/captures) or raw onig_search for capture iteration; regex 1.13.1 bytes API as a shared-syntax reference only.

corpora.generator:
# Corpus generator used by the execution profile (prose/code come from the repo
# at the baseline commit; log/unicode are generated deterministically here).
import random
S = "corpus"
random.seed(7)
paths = ["/api/v1/users", "/static/app.js", "/index.html", "/api/v2/orders", "/login", "/img/logo.png"]
agents = ["Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)", "curl/8.5.0", "Go-http-client/1.1"]
with open(S + "/log.txt", "w") as f:
    for i in range(12000):
        ip = f"{random.randint(1,254)}.{random.randint(0,255)}.{random.randint(0,255)}.{random.randint(1,254)}"
        lvl = random.choice(["INFO"] * 8 + ["WARN", "ERROR"])
        f.write(f'{ip} - - [2{i%10}/Sep/2026:{i%24:02}:{i%60:02}:{(i*7)%60:02} +0000] "{random.choice(["GET","POST"])} {random.choice(paths)}/{i} HTTP/1.1" {random.choice([200,200,200,304,404,500])} {random.randint(100,99999)} "{random.choice(agents)}" level={lvl} user=u{i%97}@example.com took={random.randint(1,999)}ms\n')
words = "Grüße aus München über Straße café naïve résumé Κόσμε καλημέρα Привет мир 世界 你好 مرحبا שלום hello world the quick brown fox jumps over lazy dog 2026 ٤٥٦".split()
with open(S + "/unicode.txt", "w") as f:
    for i in range(40000):
        f.write(random.choice(words) + (" " if i % 12 else ".\n"))
